purpose: User-selected barbell cover photos for Pulse

prompts.push: Photorealistic professional sports editorial photograph for a premium fitness website program cover. Landscape 1536x1024. Modern gym with charcoal equipment, muted neutral palette, dramatic soft side lighting, natural skin and realistic athletic build. One adult athlete in modest unbranded dark training clothes, no text, no logos or watermarks. Wide three-quarter camera framing with full athlete and relevant barbell clearly visible, centered composition that remains readable as a horizontal website card crop. Realistic anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs, correct plausible gym equipment, one straight barbell with symmetrical weight plates. An athletic man performing an INCLINE BARBELL BENCH PRESS. Bench backrest visibly inclined about 30 degrees above horizontal, head higher than hips, head back and hips supported by the bench and both feet firmly on floor. Both hands gripping the same straight barbell slightly wider than shoulders, wrists above elbows. Barbell just above upper chest during the controlled lower phase, elbows bent. Bench within a power rack with safety bars. Camera side three-quarter angle makes the inclined bench and pressing movement unmistakable. Include full bar and both ends in frame.
